nom: Neutrogena Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer

segments.oily: Oily and combination-oily reviewers widely report it controls shine and doesn't feel greasy, with many specifically recommending it for oily or acne-prone skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report mixed results: some say it stayed gentle and non-drying even on dry or sensitive skin, while others found it drying or flaky and needed to follow with a heavier moisturizer.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation and appreciate the fragrance-free formula, though one reviewer says it burned and left her skin dry and had to stop using it.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including several going through perimenopause-related breakouts, report it reduces breakouts and redness without clogging pores, though hydration can fall short overnight.
segments.mature: A couple of reviewers going through perimenopause describe their skin as aging and more breakout-prone, and report the gel helped with breakouts without additional dryness.

concerns.dehydration: Reports on hydration are split: several reviewers, including some with dry or sensitive skin, say it kept their skin comfortable and even hydrated, while many others describe it as only minimally moisturizing or outright drying, often needing a separate moisturizer layered on top or after use.
concerns.redness: Reviewers dealing with redness or swelling around blemishes report this gel reduced it, with no dissenting reports of increased redness.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report post-acne marks or dark spots fading with continued use, though at least one combination-skin reviewer saw breakouts and redness improve but no change in her dark spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including those with hormonal, cystic, or teenage acne, report fewer or smaller breakouts and faster healing, though a few say they saw little to no improvement in their acne.
concerns.oiliness: Oily and combination-skin reviewers consistently describe it as non-greasy and effective at controlling shine, with no reports of it making skin oilier.

aspects.libelle: Lightweight gel that absorbs quickly without greasy residue
Can pill or flake off with contact or layering
Mild medicinal or antiseptic smell noted by some
Bottle seen as small for the price

extraits.texte: Tried this for a few days and had to stop using it. It didn't go well with my sensitive skin. Every time I put it on it would burn and leave my skin dry the next morning even with moisturizer. Wish it worked for me but too strong for my skin. Probably work for others!

This product is just ok. It didn't really seem to help my acne much. The product name is also a little misleading. It's called a moisturizer but it's a gel and it doesn't moisturize the skin. It actually dried my skin out and made it a little flaky in the places I used it.

I have combination skin with occasional acne and breakout. I use this Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer in the morning, and layer another moisturizer on top of it at night. This gel moisturizer has a gel texture that's lightweight, absorbs quickly and non-greasy with semi-matte finish. It also layers well without pilling. The hydration is okay for morning, but not enough for night use, need to layer another moisturizer. I notice reduced redness and less breakout, but have not seen any improvement on dark spots.

Neutrogena's Evenly Clear Acne Gel Moisturizer works super well to combat acne on my oily/combination skin. It is a bit drying, so I like to pair with other hydrating products. The gel texture feels amazing on my skin and it absorbs relatively quickly. I would definitely recommend!

neutrogena evenly clear acne gel moisturizer is a lightweight product that helps clear blemishes and brighten spots. After using the product for a few weeks, a few stubborn dark spots I had on my skin started to lighten up and it helped clear some hormonal acne flare ups. I will reach for this product when I need targeted treatment.

I have extremely dry and sensitive skin. After using this product for several days, I noticed that my skin looks and feels smoother. The directions suggest using the product once a day for starters and gradually increasing to two or three times a day if necessary. I only used it once a day as my skin held its glow all day. There was no redness or dry itchy areas. My skin looks and feels amazing! I'm pleased with this product and will definitely continue using it!
